_about: Known rule keys per tier file, read by the workspace's doctor (rule keys check). A key is the label a rule line starts with: account.md '1. Key: ...', working-style.md '- Key: ...', project.md '## Key'. renamed maps an old key to its current one, so a hand-edited file still using the old key gets a warning naming the new one. A 1.x release renames a key by adding it here, never by removing the old name silently. install.py copies this file to Setup/rule-keys.json.
